# Lazy and defensive: the harness backend must not hard-depend on the validation package.
# noqa: PLC0415 — lazy
# noqa: PLC0415 — optional SDK; absent build returns []
# No marker seam on the Agent SDK query path; the prefix is content.

# Built here, not in the options translator: the collector must be readable at the result
# No marker seam on the Agent SDK query path; the prefix is content.
# Collector FIRST (validated at submit); scraper is only a fallback
# expired: set when OUR deadline (not an inner TimeoutError) fires; checked
# AFTER the client context closes, so the raise never reaches __aexit__ while
# a cancellation is in flight (see agent_sdk.drain_until_result).
# A fresh Timeout cm per anext(): the deadline is one shared
# instant, but bounding only the await (never the yield below)
# means the clock never spans control handed back to the caller.
# .expired() tells OUR deadline apart from a TimeoutError
# raised inside the session itself.
# Grace drain: give the interrupted session a chance to
# settle before __aexit__ runs with no cancellation pending.
# Raised OUTSIDE the client's `async with`: __aexit__ already ran clean.
